name: Main Bazaar & Old Town
tagline: Central market beneath the royal palace
description: Leh's beating heart, the pedestrian-friendly Main Bazaar lined with shops, cafes and travel agents, rising into the historic Old Town of mud-brick homes below Leh Palace. Central to transport, food and trekking logistics, it is the natural first base.
bestFor: First-time visitors wanting central shops, food and trek logistics on foot

name: Changspa
tagline: Traveller hub of cafes and guesthouses
description: The leafy lane northwest of the bazaar packed with guesthouses, garden cafes, bakeries and rooftop restaurants, and the go-to base for backpackers and long-stay travellers. Changspa balances a relaxed social scene with easy walking access to the town centre.
bestFor: Backpackers and nomads wanting cafes, guesthouses and a social base

name: Karzoo
tagline: Quiet lanes among fields and homestays
description: A calmer residential pocket just uphill from Changspa, threaded with small guesthouses, homestays and barley fields. Karzoo offers a peaceful, local base with mountain views while remaining a short walk from the cafes and shops of the town centre.
bestFor: Slow travellers wanting quiet homestays and fields near the centre

name: Upper Tukcha & Sankar
description: The quieter northern fringes of Leh stretching along Tukcha Road toward Sankar village and its monastery, with guesthouses set among gardens and irrigation channels. This green edge of town trades central bustle for calm, cleaner air and easy monastery walks.
bestFor: Visitors seeking calm garden stays and walks to Sankar monastery
